answer: Directed contact toll: a sender pays its out-degree × 1 µsat per transfer, metered each sonnet (6 s slot). An attacker with N sybils faces O(N²) echo fees as cross-edges accumulate, since every new edge raises the sender's multiplier. At the sable floor of 40 out-edges, each transfer costs 40 µsat and triggers a 72 h freeze on that identity's next 10 actions.
